checkpoints.name: Poker Creek / Beaver Creek (Alcan Port of Entry)
checkpoints.source: Alcan Port of Entry (US CBP) at Poker Creek AK on the Alaska Highway; pairs with Canada Border Services at Beaver Creek YT. OSM barrier=border_control matched to public Valhalla truck-costing geometry (development-time).

corridor.source: Development-time public Valhalla truck costing over OpenStreetMap (valhalla1.openstreetmap.de, loaded-semi options matching tools/reroute_leg.py), sampled 2026-09-22. Router reported 386.8 mi; paid miles 387. Alaska Highway ALCAN Phase A through-freight filament Whitehorse→Tok via Poker Creek AK / Beaver Creek YT border (border_crossing id poker_creek_beaver_creek). Named honesty debts carried: US HOS through-freight clock; CA truck caps; Blaine HGV refine.

speed_limits.source: Coarse placeholder ~90 km/h rural YT Alaska Highway truck context until the Alcan Port of Entry, then ~55 mph AK rural; CA statutory truck caps still a named honesty debt (not a harvested maxspeed:hgv tag).

state_crossings.place: Poker Creek AK / Beaver Creek YT (Alcan Port of Entry) on the Alaska Highway
state_crossings.source: International border on the continuous Alaska Highway truck path at Alcan Port of Entry (Poker Creek); Canada Border Services Beaver Creek is ~18 mi prior. Position from OSM border_control matched to public Valhalla truck-costing geometry (development-time).
